messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Cinder runs its planning on Mondays. [valid 2026-04-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-03]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: Diego is on Cinder. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, Diego holds the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- On 2026-03-11 the Cinder team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder. [valid 2025-01-08 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-16]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The authentication gateway is owned by Cinder as of 2025-09-16, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-01-30 the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- Per the 2026-04-14 Dune team standup, Farah is release captain for Q3 2025. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-3]
- As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-09-23; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune team on-call shift, taking over from Farah. [valid 2025-09-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
    earlier: Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-13 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]

Question: Who is on call for Cinder right now?
